text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Lukewarm.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Out of My way!! That path... belongs to 
Us!!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa...!!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Orfevre...!! —So intense! 
She's sooooo strong!!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah... Right now... I'm pumped up—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What unbelievable spirit on display! 
Orfevre reaches the goaaal!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Don't make a fuss over something like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh...! What an incredible run, 
Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's Dream Journey's little sister, 
right? Man, she really is crazy 
talented...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text: "Lady Orfeeeeevre! Congratulations...!!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, sure, congrats to her and all. 
But is she really good enough to become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Let's check it out! Come on, let's go to 
the Japan Derby too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. The look on everyone's 
faces... changed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"She's smiling. She's thrilled... She's 
dreaming—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...This is... that person's... light.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The lead...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, it's fine. I... already knew that 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"The real stage for me is the Japan 
Derby... I've got to work even harder 
until then...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Me, the star of the show...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Praise and revere.

True to her word, Orfevre claimed the 
first crown. And what comes next is—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is next, huh?

The Nippon Derby is a 2,400m Classic race 
held at Tokyo Racecourse, holding a 
special significance for everyone in the 
racing world.
choice_data_list: The dream of everyone in racing...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A dream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Do you also desire to be a Derby 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You truly are a fortunate man. Your dream—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You truly are a fortunate woman. Your 
dream—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It seems it will come true. ...All of it, 
that is.

Orfevre smirks fearlessly. Her next target 
race is the Japanese Derby... There is no 
path forward except victory.

With Orfevre, she can surely become a 
Derby Umamusume too. The moment that 
strong thought crossed my mind, I suddenly 
felt the presence of the pendant close by.
That night, I had a strange dream—

The day of the Japan Derby... Tokyo 
Racecourse was covered in rain clouds, and 
puddles formed on the track.

Even after I woke up, the ceaseless sound 
of rain continued to echo in my ears for a 
long while...
